'''Ueli Maurer''' (born 26 May 1960<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Maurer, Ueli, Prof. Dr. {{!}} ETH Zurich|url=https://qc.ethz.ch/members/person-detail.umaurer.html|access-date=2021-12-09|website=qc.ethz.ch|language=en|archive-date=2021-12-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211209051655/https://qc.ethz.ch/members/person-detail.umaurer.html|url-status=live}}</ref>) is a professor of [[cryptography]] at the [[ETH Zurich|Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich]] (ETH Zurich).

== Education ==
Maurer studied electrical engineering at ETH Zurich and obtained his PhD in 1990,<ref name=":0" /> advised by [[James Massey]].<ref>{{Cite thesis|title=Provable security in cryptography|url=https://www.research-collection.ethz.ch/handle/20.500.11850/140005|publisher=ETH Zurich|date=1990|degree=Doctoral Thesis|language=en|first=Ueli|last=Maurer|archive-date=2022-02-25|access-date=2022-02-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220225212841/https://www.research-collection.ethz.ch/handle/20.500.11850/140005|url-status=live}}</ref> He joined [[Princeton University]] as a postdoc from 1990 to 1991.<ref name=":0" />

== Career ==
In a seminal work, he showed that the [[Diffie-Hellman problem]] is (under certain conditions) [[Equivalence relation|equivalent]] to solving the [[discrete log]] problem.<ref name="MAURER">Ueli Maurer: ''Towards the equivalence of breaking the Diffie-Hellman protocol and computing discrete logarithms.'' In: ''Advances in Cryptology – Crypto '94.'' Springer-Verlag, 1994, S. 271−281.</ref>

From 2002 until 2008, Maurer also served on the board of [[Tamedia|Tamedia AG]].<ref name="TAMEDIA">[http://www.tamedia.ch/de/mediencorner/medienmitteilungen/Seiten/Jahresabschluss2007Medienmitteilung.aspx Tamedia AG Medienmitteilung 23. April 2008: Jahresabschluss 2007] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120112044703/http://www.tamedia.ch/de/mediencorner/medienmitteilungen/Seiten/Jahresabschluss2007Medienmitteilung.aspx |date=2012-01-12 }}</ref>

Maurer was appointed editor-in-chief of the [[Journal of Cryptology]] in 2002<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ueli Maurer appointed Editor-in-Chief of the Journal of Cryptology|url=https://www.iacr.org/newsletter/v19n1/journal.html|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020427161717/https://www.iacr.org/newsletter/v19n1/journal.html|archive-date=27 April 2002|access-date=9 December 2021|website=www.iacr.org}}</ref> for a three-year term.<ref>{{Cite web |date=19 August 2001 |title=Minutes of the Board of Directors Meeting at Crypto 2001 |url=https://www.iacr.org/newsletter/v19n2/minutes.c2001bod.html |access-date=30 December 2022 |website=www.iacr.org}}</ref> He was reappointed to a second three-year term as editor-in-chief of the same journal from 2005.<ref>{{Cite web |date=15 August 2004 |title=Board of Directors Meeting Crypto 2004 |url=https://www.iacr.org/docs/minutes/c2004bod.txt |access-date=30 December 2022 |website=www.iacr.org |archive-date=2 April 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230402082733/https://www.iacr.org/docs/minutes/c2004bod.txt |url-status=live }}</ref>

In 2008, Maurer was named a Fellow of the [[International Association for Cryptologic Research]] "for fundamental contributions to information-theoretic cryptography, service to the IACR, and sustained educational leadership in cryptology."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.iacr.org/fellows/2008/Maurer.html|title=Ueli Maurer, IACR Fellow|website=www.iacr.org|access-date=2018-11-25|archive-date=2019-02-03|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190203011427/https://www.iacr.org/fellows/2008/Maurer.html|url-status=live}}</ref> In 2015, he was named a [[List of Fellows of the Association for Computing Machinery|Fellow of the Association for Computing Machinery]] "for contributions to cryptography and [[information security]]."<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.acm.org/press-room/news-releases/2015/fellows-2015|title=ACM Fellows Named for Computing Innovations that Are Advancing Technology in the Digital Age|publisher=[[Association for Computing Machinery]]|year=2015|accessdate=2015-12-09|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151209221613/http://www.acm.org/press-room/news-releases/2015/fellows-2015|archivedate=2015-12-09}}.</ref> In 2016, he was awarded the [[RSA Award for Excellence in Mathematics]].<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-03-01|title=RSA® Conference 2016 Announces Recipients of Annual Awards; Lifetime Achievement Award Presented to Art Coviello, Jr|url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20160301005105/en/RSA%C2%AE-Conference-2016-Announces-Recipients-of-Annual-Awards-Lifetime-Achievement-Award-Presented-to-Art-Coviello-Jr|access-date=2021-12-09|website=www.businesswire.com|language=en|archive-date=2021-12-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211209051651/https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20160301005105/en/RSA%C2%AE-Conference-2016-Announces-Recipients-of-Annual-Awards-Lifetime-Achievement-Award-Presented-to-Art-Coviello-Jr|url-status=live}}</ref>

== Accolades ==
* 2016: [[RSA Security]] (RSA) Award for Excellence in Mathematics
* 2015: Fellow of the [[Association for Computing Machinery]] (ACM)
* 2008: Fellow of the [[International Association for Cryptologic Research]] (IACR)
* 2007: Member of the [[German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]]
* 2003: Fellow of the [[IEEE]]
